name: Analisis Temporal de Textura de Piel
description: Examina la consistencia de la textura de la piel y la preservacion de micro-detalles en cuadros de video.
useCase: Detecting AI-generated faces through temporal skin texture anomalies
mechanism: Analyzes pore-level skin texture, wrinkle patterns, and micro-surface details across consecutive frames. AI-generated faces often show unnatural smoothness, texture flickering, or inconsistent skin detail levels that vary between frames.
source: Li, L. et al. (2020) - Face X-Ray for More General Face Forgery Detection, CVPR
algorithm: Texture Feature Extraction (LBP/Gabor) + Temporal Coherence + Statistical Analysis
parameters: Patch size: 32x32, Features: LBP, Gabor magnitude, Texture gradient, Frame window: 15
